(WebFetch content — Scottish Government press release, 28 July 2026 10:05)
"Continued progress in tackling Cairngorms wildfire." Scottish Fire and Rescue Service reports positive progress; Level 3 response continuing. Fire began 15 July; affected ~25 sq km (aerial assessment). Previous evacuations at Nethy Bridge LIFTED on 27 July; no active evacuations. Support for Nethy Bridge residents continues via Local Resilience Partnership.
Officials: First Minister John Swinney chaired the Scottish Government Resilience Room (SGoRR); Deputy First Minister Jenny Gilruth; Justice Secretary Neil Gray; Climate Action & Rural Affairs Secretary Gillian Martin.
UK Government declined a military aerial-firefighting request (MoD has no aerial firefighting assets stationed in the UK).
(NB: On 27 July SFRS had ~70 firefighters, 9 appliances plus specialist wildfire resources on scene. No new Cairngorms evacuation on 28 July. Coalsnaughton, Clackmannanshire: searches indicate the Coalsnaughton incident relates to mining-related ground movement/subsidence — not confirmed as a wildfire in available 28-July sources; treat with caution.)
